instruction: Convert the LibreOffice Writer document into a podcast audio file with automatic text-to-speech and upload to streaming platform.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have text-to-speech audio export capabilities or podcast creation features. Converting documents to audio formats with narration requires specialized audio processing software.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function for a task that cannot be completed in the OSWorld environment
LibreOffice Writer indeed lacks text-to-speech and podcast creation capabilities
The task requires external specialized audio processing software and streaming platform access beyond the desktop environment
The 'infeasible' marker is the semantically appropriate evaluator for tasks that cannot be verified because they cannot be completed
